covers: the stored summary, result rows, counters and exact replay
an extracted ledger worksheet and an extracted output-VAT report admitted through the parsed entry
every pairing total identical to the decoded-row entry for the same content
a report that needs OCR, an unrecognised column set, an empty report, a missing report side and an unknown source kind refused before anything is stored
company scope and the recon feature, a revoked workspace permission, generic writes and shares, the immutable identity, pagination and deletion

checks.note: the new error keys are ASCII semantic keys, following the existing reconciliation.* convention

intentional_differences: the entry takes already-extracted content (sheet rows, per-page text and tables, printed lines, decoded delimited text, pipeline entries); opening the files, the encoding sniff, OCR and model calls stay in the legacy project, and the dispatch is by a named source kind instead of by file extension
a scanned report or an unrecognised column set returns None (the deployed signal to fall back to a model or the unified pipeline); the admission turns it into a refusal instead
the stored row keeps the six fields the pairing reads, so the report tax id, branch, VAT amount, gross amount and row number are not stored yet
MIN_DETERMINISTIC_ROWS is exported for callers but not used as a routing rule on this side: it decides whether the deployed run would switch to a model, which the store does not need
a malformed source shape raises ReconciliationContractError, consistent with the ledger parsing and the stored contract, where the deployed code returned an error dict or None
not_run: reading a real workbook, PDF or delimited file, and the Gemini or unified-pipeline OCR path with its billing and engine policy
file diagnostics and file names in storage, asynchronous jobs and polling, the review workbook export, batch delete
frontend integration, deployment, external business results and user acceptance
